technique_name: Outline the main points about the given topic in two paragraphs.
description: Hybrid cars offer a number of advantages compared to traditional gas-powered vehicles. The most notable benefit is the fuel efficiency they offer due to the utilization of both a gasoline engine and an electric motor. This efficient combination allows hybrid vehicles to produce up to twice the fuel economy of conventional heavy-duty vehicles, with some hybrids achieving up to 125 miles per gallon. In addition to fuel efficiency, hybrids have a lower environmental impact than gasoline-powered car
